description: This file declares the RippleHandler class, which manages WebSocket connections and event handling for ripple-related functionalities within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It includes methods for initialization, termination, and sending intents, and references external WebSocket and event handler classes.

classes.name: RippleHandler
classes.description: A class responsible for managing WebSocket connections and event handling related to ripple functionalities within the plugin.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the RippleHandler with an event handler.

methods.name: terminate
methods.description: Terminates the RippleHandler, cleaning up resources.

methods.name: sendIntent
methods.description: Sends an intent with specified appId and intent string, returning an error reason if any.
